GRE (Graduate Record Examination)
About the GRE:
The GRE is a required admissions test for some graduate programs at UTRGV. It includes:
Verbal Reasoning
Quantitative Reasoning
Analytical Writing
Cost: $205
Register Online: GRE Registration
Test Centers and Dates: Schedule Your GRE General Test
Free Practice Materials: POWERPREP Practice Tests
GRE Fee Reduction Program: ETS offers GRE fee reduction waivers for eligible college seniors and unenrolled college graduates. Eligible candidates pay only 50% of the test fee. There is also a program for the unemployed on a first-come, first-served basis.
Check Eligibility Criteria
Download the GRE 50% Fee Reduction Request Form
More information on Fee Reduction Program
GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test)
About the GMAT:
The GMAT is required for some business programs at UTRGV. It includes:
Analytical Writing Assessment
Integrated Reasoning
Quantitative
Verbal
Cost: $250
Register Online: GMAT Registration
Determining Exam Requirements
To find out if your desired master’s or doctoral program requires the GRE or GMAT, visit our Graduate Programs Page, and select your program of interest.
Free GRE & GMAT Practice Tests
UTRGV students, staff, and faculty can access free practice exams and study guides:
Visit our University Library webpage for more information.
Testing Services
For the latest information on taking the GRE or GMAT exams at UTRGV, visit the UTRGV Testing Services website.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is the GRE required?
Some graduate programs require the GRE. Requirements and waivers vary by department. Visit our Graduate Programs webpage for specifics.
Is the GMAT required?
The GMAT is preferred for programs like Human Resource Management (MS), Global Trade Management (MS), or the Ph.D. in Business. Check the Graduate Programs webpage for details.
How can I prepare for the GRE or GMAT?
Utilize free preparation materials provided by the UTRGV Library for students, staff, and faculty.
Purchase GRE or GMAT prep books online or at a local bookstore.
